title: directions don't come in english
text: directions don't come in english. I believe I had it on right, the center cup area was hot to the touch but the directions only come in one language and it wasn't english, it didn't keep my hot coffee hot and it didn't seem to slow down the cooling time. I tried a few different cups with different thickness on the bottom but it didn't seem to make a difference.
